scope: Manual inspection of screenshots from the real Fabric development-client integrated-world test
overview: Leader display name, measured CPU interval, measured share, frame percentiles and CPU/GPU limitations are readable.
selectedInstance: A cyan bounding box surrounds the actual chest, with two legible world labels above it.
inspector: The crosshair targets the chest and the HUD shows its real average/P95/peak/calls.
smallWindow: Capture controls, summary and export fit at 320x240; a temporary vanilla advancement toast can overlap the screen title.
